lines.text: Eve gives birth to Cain, and later to Abel, who keeps sheep while Cain tills the soil.
Cain brings fruit of the soil, Abel brings the best of his flock, and the LORD favors Cain's offering.

wrong_details.true: the LORD looked with favor on Abel and his offering, but had no regard for Cain's

lines.text: Cain asks Abel to go out to the field and kills him, then tells the LORD he does not know where Abel is.
The LORD curses Cain, who will be a fugitive, and puts a mark on him, and Cain settles in the land of Goshen.
Adam and Eve have a son named Seth, and Seth's son Enosh is born when men begin to call on the LORD.
